title: Correct final release metadata digest binding
rawUserRequest: 修复 v0.5.63 官方 release-digests.json 中 release.json 的陈旧摘要；从根因修复生成流程和校验，并发布下一个修正版版本。

declaredIntent.summary: Make the final public release.json digest binding source-consistent and prevent recurrence in future releases.

outOfScope: Do not modify, delete, move, or re-upload v0.5.63 tag or its immutable release assets.
Do not change installer behavior, archive source content, or unrelated Work Items.
Do not publish a tag or Draft Release before local and hosted release gates pass.

sources.reason: The generator currently mutates release.json after generating its release-digests artifact.
Defines the final release-digests artifact and its release.json digest field.
Public verification currently does not require or compare the release.json asset.
Defines the export-ignore archive boundary and the prior runtime manifest projection.
Workflow ordering and publication-side regression coverage.
Public asset integrity and provider asset fixture coverage.
Canonical release asset authority and archive boundary documentation.
Prior correction that introduced runtime digest archive projection and its current self-reference boundary.
Public immutable release evidence reported by the user and independently checked.

riskAssessment.reason: A stale public digest can make an otherwise installable release fail evidence verification; the correction changes a release workflow and its public verifier.

reasons: Public release evidence and immutable publication boundary require strict verification.

override.approvalEvidence: User authorized the root-cause correction and subsequent new patch release in this conversation.
override.reason: Prevent recurrence of a public release digest mismatch.
notRunChecks: Provider-side release execution is deferred until the merged source is available.

executionDecision.reason: The user authorized the bounded root-cause correction and subsequent new patch release; the exact merged source identity remains deferred to release finalization.

authorityEvidence.scope: Root-cause correction, governed merge, and publication of the next patch release only; preserve v0.5.63.

preReviewWarnings: Do not rewrite v0.5.63; prove the new version's public release.json and release-digests.json are mutually consistent.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: The release workflow generates the final archive before the final release.json digest manifest, and the final manifest records the exact public release.json bytes after archive SHA binding.
Mutable release projections are not embedded in the source archive, eliminating the release.json/archive/manifest self-reference cycle; the archive SHA still matches the published archive asset.
The archive builder has no runtime release-digest projection option, so a future workflow cannot reintroduce the self-reference through a convenience flag.
The public distribution checker requires release.json as a release asset and rejects any mismatch between its bytes and release-digests.json.artifacts.release.json before installer execution.
Human Benefit Reports remain digest-bound after pre-archive candidate coverage mutates the Outcome, and resolved historical stops do not replace the current next action.
Focused regression tests cover workflow ordering, missing or stale release.json public assets, digest mismatch, and a valid complete asset set; existing fail-closed gates remain enabled.
English, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese release verification documentation state the independent public asset binding and immutable historical-release correction rule.

After this Work Item is merged and closed, the next available patch release is published and its downloaded release.json, release-digests.json, archive, installer, tag, source commit, and provider evidence pass the post-publish checks.
guidelines: Release evidence must be generated only after final runtime release metadata is complete.
The immutable historical v0.5.63 tag and assets are preserved; correction uses a new patch tag.
Every public release asset claim must be checked against downloaded bytes before publication or installer execution.
Do not weaken, skip, or xfail release, archive, installer, smoke, compatibility, or fail-closed checks.
Human Benefit Reports must be regenerated after any post-generation Outcome mutation, and resolved stops must not become current recovery actions.
Document the same release boundary and recovery semantics in English, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese.

intent.problem: The v0.5.63 public release manifest declares a stale SHA-256 for the public release.json asset because the workflow changes release.json after generating release-digests.json. The prior runtime archive projection couples the manifest to an archive hash that is itself stored in release.json, so the ordering cannot produce a stable final binding.
constraints: Do not broaden the Work Item beyond this release evidence path.
Publish only a new patch release after exact-source hosted verification.
intent.rationale: Decoupling mutable release projections from the archive and regenerating the public digest manifest after the final release.json mutation removes the self-reference and makes the public asset digest checkable.
